ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat on 21 Nov 2026 for PR #1858. On releasing: "let's release it", after "Test Keep/power cycle first" and "You merge when green". When the author's pool commit brought back a stuck FLEX pick: "Let's fix it ourselves, I finally want this thingy to go out", and on the author's OK for that change: "I'm waiving that". After the release build 394fa397, the waiver, its known limit and the untested items were disclosed: "Approve, release it". Asked to add current-build-hardware because the MIDI flood did not count stuck notes after a channel change or end-to-end lost messages: "Yes, add it". When the author's selected-track audition commit (cc6bb25e) changed the build: "Unit trial first". After the trial of release package ff5ac017, with the same waivers, the known limit and the untested items disclosed: "Approve, release it".
reason: First release of Grain 0.1.0-experimental, exact native source only (release package ff5ac017…, MKII OS 1.40C). The static zero-wait bound (157,940 core cycles for 16 source frames, side-first build) exceeds the 95,782-cycle frame budget, so chip worst-case cycles are waived. The longest measured guarded callback is 33,640 cycles, against the 35-point reservation that limits a Part to one Grain track. Exact static sizes are recorded (27,908 bytes of code and data, 2,860 of BSS, a 756-byte audio stack), but no full memory-region inventory, so complete memory bounds are waived. On the owner's MKII, card-free in RAM, the release package played T1, picked FLEX after a pool jump, kept Grain's engine running on T1 while the pool was open on T5 and took the plain Flex path while it was open on T1, then rolled back; build 394fa397 before the author's selected-track change also picked FLEX after a double tap and LEFT. Its audio path differs from the side-first build only by a pool-window check. That build played T1 and T5 with USB audio capture closed and under a 240 BPM MIDI flood with no render skips and no frame over the deadline, and was kept over USB on shipping base 254c5a75, restored after a power cycle and removed. Known limit, also in the earlier builds: after a pool opened on the Grain track from a page other than SRC and closed, FUNC+SRC cannot pick FLEX or STATIC until the SRC page is shown or another track is selected. Current-build hardware is waived because that evidence is incomplete: the MIDI flood counted no stuck notes after a MIDI channel change and no end-to-end lost messages. Not tested: the pool audition's sound on the unit, project save and reload with Grain, a full module set, the lean Main USB layout, MKI on this build and the owner's listening check (six overlapping grains are much louder than one Flex voice). This exception applies to no other version or source.
